<p>“Hoo.”</p><p>Today’s the day.</p><p>At first, the week had felt endless, but in the blink of an eye, it was over. Before I knew it, the morning of the wedding had arrived.</p><p>Nerus came to my house this morning. He said there was no need for me to struggle with the journey—he would open the door for me himself.</p><p>Echo left with the words that from now on, I wouldn’t be able to see the bride, then took Yu-na, Na-hyeon, and Ji-hyeon through the door with him.</p><p>Nerus told me that crossing the door would take me to the gate leading to Echo’s castle. He also mentioned that he had already laid detection magic around the area, so any human who approached would be immediately exposed to him and Echo. Because of that, he told Han Ji-hyeok that there was no need for the Hunter Association personnel guarding the front to stay, and they all withdrew on the spot.</p><p>“Now that there are no humans there, Seong-hyeon-nim can cross over in your formal attire.”</p><p>“Ah, yes. But how long will the ceremony take?”</p><p>“Apart from His Majesty, who will officiate the wedding, and Yuria, who will assist with the process, the only guests are Seong-hyeon-nim’s sisters and myself. It will be over before evening.”</p><p>“I see.”</p><p>After putting on the tuxedo I would wear for the ceremony, I stood before Nerus. He gave me a kind smile and meticulously adjusted my tie and other details.</p><p>“Thank you.”</p><p>“First weddings make anyone nervous. Let’s go.”</p><p>Nerus led me to the door.</p><p>I thought I was hiding it well, but Nerus seemed to have noticed my nerves right away.</p><p>When I had just officially become a Hunter, I asked several senior married Hunters who were on the same team as me. They all said things like, “Before I knew it, I was standing in front of the venue,” or “I wasn’t nervous at all until the morning, but the moment I stepped through the ceremony hall doors, my hands were shaking like crazy.” Turns out they were right.</p><p>As I stood before this door, my hands and feet trembled with nerves. It wasn’t the kind of shaking that came from facing a powerful enemy—it was an indescribable, strange tremor. I wondered if this was what it felt like when excitement reached its peak.</p><p>And the thought that after today, I would truly become a woman’s husband and the head of a household only made the trembling worse.</p><p>Doubt crept in. *Can I really do this? Do I even deserve this?* My past mistakes flashed through my mind.</p><p>“Seong-hyeon-nim?”</p><p>“Ah, sorry. Let’s go.”</p><p>Nerus nodded with a smile, as if my reaction was only natural.</p><p>I took a few more deep breaths before stepping toward the door.</p><p>Only now, in my nervous state, did I notice something: the door Nerus had summoned today wasn’t like the last one, oozing ominous energy with blood-like liquid seeping from it. Instead, it was made of a white marble-like material, and the inside of the door was filled with white light.</p><p>Probably the door’s true form was the eerie one, but Nerus must have changed its appearance so Yu-na and the others wouldn’t be scared when they first crossed through.</p><p>‘He really is considerate and thorough… It makes sense that someone like him would become emperor…’</p><p>Whoosh</p><p>As I passed through the door, white light engulfed me. After a few more steps, the light cleared, and I found myself standing in front of the gate entrance.</p><p>“Let’s go straight to the palace.”</p><p>“Yes.”</p><p>***</p><p>I’m sitting in the waiting room with Nerus. Maybe I looked really nervous, because Nerus made me tea himself. It’s a high-end black tea, a gift from the Association.</p><p>“I thought we’d have more than enough since we received such a huge amount from Lord Ji-hyeok, but we’re already running low.”</p><p>“Already? How many cups do you drink a day?”</p><p>“About twenty when I’m here.”</p><p>“···.”</p><p>“Plus, many nobles have been requesting it, so His Majesty has been bestowing it as gifts. When I asked Lord Ji-hyeok, he said it’s a top-tier tea produced in very limited quantities. They bought up all the stock available on the market, and it’ll take time to restock.”</p><p>Nerus took a sip of tea and wore a lonely expression.</p><p>Even I, who knows nothing about tea, could tell this was an extravagant luxury item. The aroma and flavor were exceptional.</p><p>“Are you feeling less tense now?”</p><p>“Yes, thank you.”</p><p>Talking with Nerus had helped ease my nerves a little.</p><p>“We’ll be entering the banquet hall soon. The path there is completely dark.”</p><p>“Huh? So I won’t be able to see anything?”</p><p>“That’s right. Just keep walking, and a door will appear before you know it. Open it and go in. I’ll guide you, so don’t worry.”</p><p>“Okay.”</p><p>Hearing that the moment to enter the banquet hall had come, my hands and feet grew clammy again, and I started to tremble a little. But it was definitely better than before.</p><p>“It’s time. Let’s go.”</p><p>Squeak</p><p>The door opened, and Nerus stepped forward first. I followed behind him.</p><p>Once the door closed, I truly couldn’t see a thing in front of me.</p><p>“Just follow the sound of my footsteps.”</p><p>“Okay.”</p><p>I slowly walked through the darkness, following the clacking of Nerus’s shoes. Strangely, even though I couldn’t see anything, I didn’t feel uneasy or afraid. In fact, my mind was at ease.</p><p>After walking for about a minute, a door with light seeping through it came into view.</p><p>“Just open that door and go through.”</p><p>“Yes, thank you.”</p><p>I gripped the doorknob and tightly closed my eyes. A fragrant floral scent was wafting through the crack in the door.</p><p>Echo had said they prepared the wedding ceremony by blending human customs with their own. Maybe the flowers were part of that.</p><p>Click</p><p>As I turned the doorknob, I heard Ji-hyeon’s and Na-hyeon’s voices from beyond the door.</p><p>“They’re coming in!”</p><p>Squeak</p><p>“Whoa···.”</p><p>And the moment I opened the door, I was left speechless.</p><p>This was unmistakably a space created by magic. The vast expanse stretched beyond the horizon, entirely filled with flower fields, and the intoxicating scent of blossoms filled the air.</p><p>At the front stood Echo with a solemn expression, and on either side, Na-hyeon and Ji-hyeon were seated in prepared chairs.</p><p>But in this surreal, dreamlike scene, my eyes could only see one person.</p><p>I silently approached her, the one standing before Echo.</p><p>She looked at me and smiled as brightly as a child.</p><p>Then, holding up the bouquet in her hands, she said,</p><p>“Isn’t it so beautiful here?”</p><p>But I couldn’t see the flowers. To me, nothing in the world mattered except the woman in front of me.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291498" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Yeah, it’s so beautiful it makes me want to cry.”</p><p>“Honey?”</p><p>I didn’t even know why I was like this. The memories of reuniting with Yu-na, the life-and-death struggles we’d faced together… every moment we’d shared, every emotion we’d nurtured—it all flashed through my mind, and tears welled up in my eyes.</p><p>“Oh no! Honey?”</p><p>Yu-na, startled by my tears, quickly began wiping them away.</p><p>“Sorry… I’m just so happy and overwhelmed that the tears won’t stop.”</p><p>Yu-na silently wiped my tears with a joyful expression. Just as I managed to steady my surging emotions, Echo’s voice rang out.</p><p>“Let the two to be wed come before me.”</p><p>“Yes.”</p><p>Yu-na reached out her hand, and I took it before walking forward together toward Echo.</p><p>Echo studied us for a few seconds, then nodded and spoke.</p><p>“Under the heavens, the earth, and all the names of the empire, I bear witness to your vows today. Do you swear to share joy and hardship until the end of your lives, to never abandon each other in golden days or ashen nights?”</p><p>Yu-na and I locked eyes, smiled, and answered in unison,</p><p>“We do.”</p><p>“I have woven countless fates, but few threads have been as clear as this bond today. By my will and the world’s proof, you are now bound by destiny.”</p><p>The moment Echo finished speaking, a black light enveloped us, and I felt a strange sensation as if Yu-na’s hand and mine were merging. It was an unfamiliar feeling, as though we had become one.</p><p>Yu-na must have felt the same, because she stared at me in surprise.</p><p>‘So this is the ritual that binds souls.’</p><p>“Now it cannot be undone.”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>Echo smiled as she looked at us, then called out,</p><p>“Nerus!”</p><p>“Yes, Your Majesty. It has been recorded.”</p><p>“Good. You two are now recorded in the empire’s history as husband and wife. Without my permission, the marriage cannot be annulled.”</p><p>“Your Majesty, thank you.”</p><p>“Echo… thank you so much.”</p><p>Echo nodded in satisfaction, and then we silently stared at each other before clasping hands and kissing.</p><p>I could feel Yu-na’s lips trembling. Mine were probably shaking even more than hers.</p><p>And just like that, we became each other’s bound companions.</p><p>“Hngh…”</p><p>“Hm?”</p><p>While we were kissing, a strange sound caught our attention. Yu-na and I turned to see Ji-hyeon crying.</p><p>“Ji-hyeon?”</p><p>“It’s just… so moving, I can’t help but cry…”</p><p>With those words, Ji-hyeon started sobbing—with a smile on her face.</p><p>Na-hyeon burst out laughing, then wrapped her arms around Ji-hyeon to comfort her.</p><p>‘Is she crying or laughing?’</p><p>Nerus was clapping with a kind expression, and Yuria stood beside him, beaming brightly.</p><p>“Good. Next is the banquet.”</p><p>***</p><p>After the wedding ceremony, a grand banquet followed. Everyone sat together, enjoying the food.</p><p>Of course, all the dishes at the banquet were made by Yu-na, but today, they tasted even more special and delicious.</p><p>Echo enjoyed the food and drink while offering us words of praise. It almost made me feel a sudden surge of loyalty toward him.</p><p>‘Still, thanks to Echo, we even got married…’</p><p>***</p><p>Once the banquet ended and night fell, it was time for bed. Nerus offered to guide us to a special room he had prepared for our first night, but Yu-na said she wanted to stay in the room I usually used when I visited. Nerus simply told us to do as we pleased and allowed it.</p><p>With a reverent heart, I finished my bath and walked toward the room. Since it was our first night, even Yuria didn’t assist with the bathing.</p><p>Behind this door, my companion awaited.</p><p>This wasn’t just a legal marriage like ordinary people. No—my true wife, bound to me in the most sacred way, with our souls tied as one, was waiting inside.</p><p>Squeak.</p><p>When I opened the door, Yu-na was sitting on the bed. It felt strange to see her there instead of Yuria.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291499" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Honey, you’re here?”</p><p>“Yeah, Yu-na… what’s that outfit?”</p><p>“H-Hey… Echo gave it to me as a gift.”</p><p>I answered with a smile, then sat beside her and said,</p><p>“Thank you for marrying me. Let’s be happy together forever.”</p><p>“Yeah… forever… happy.”</p><p>A hot tear rolled down Yu-na’s cheek. I gently wiped it away, then kissed her.</p><p>And so, our first night as husband and wife began.</p>
